image_description: A flat-lay photograph of an open vintage comic book spread. The pages show signs of aging (yellowing) and wear. The layout consists of multiple irregular panels containing hand-drawn illustrations in a gritty, underground comix style. Visible elements include grotesque characters, action scenes, speech bubbles with handwritten text, and caption boxes. The binding is visible on the left edge, appearing to be saddle-stitched.

artifact_observations.location: Speech bubbles and caption boxes throughout the page
artifact_observations.reasoning: While the text mimics the visual structure of handwriting, close inspection reveals that many letterforms are malformed, inconsistent, or nonsensical (pseudo-text). This is a common AI artifact where the model replicates the 'look' of text without generating valid orthography.

The texture of the paper is overly uniform in its 'aged' appearance, lacking the natural variation of fiber and wear. Some ink lines bleed into the paper texture in a way that suggests digital smudging rather than physical ink absorption.

Some panel borders waver or disappear inconsistently. Character hands and feet in the lower panels show slight structural ambiguity or fusion with the background/props, typical of generative models struggling with complex anatomy in small scales.
